svg.text: OPTION 5 - FIRST FLOOR: clean rectangular hall, stair and family corridor behind it
Hall 43'6" x 16'4" average = 709 sqft with nothing inside it. External stair arrives on the west of the lobby, hall toilets are on the east. Bedroom 3 reached by the internal stair and bridge.
ROAD / GATE (NORTH) on the left. Top edge = EAST neighbour house (our new 9" wall). Bottom edge = WEST apartment (existing wall). Right = BACK (existing wall).

Plot 106' x 21' (20' at back). East: 6" compound wall + 1'3" setback. West: 1' setback from the apartment wall. Outer walls 9", partitions 6". All room sizes are inside wall faces. Positions are feet from the front boundary.
west setback 1' from the apartment wall
NEEM TREE: trunk 3'6" from road, 7'6" from west,
leans in to ~8'. Slab above starts at 14'.
VOID: external stair below, arrives at 24' and turns onto the lobby
rectangular, no pillars, no stair inside. 60 chairs in 10 rows of 6, 7' stage at the back
width 16'6" at the front, 16'1" at the back (average used above)
windows both sides at sill 4' (legal because of the setbacks), back wall window onto the stair band
Overhead tank on this wing's roof (about 21' high): enough head for the hall toilets.
